tagline: Tumhara laptop Wi-Fi network kaise dhoondta hai aur kaise sabit karta hai ki use password pata hai.
description: Wi-Fi network join karne mein hawa mein ek chhoti si baatcheet hoti hai. Laptop access point ke beacons sunta hai, hello kehta hai, join karta hai, aur phir 4-way handshake chalata hai: dono sides password kabhi bheje bina sabit karte hain ki unhe password pata hai, aur fresh keys par agree karte hain jo uske baad har frame ko encrypt karti hain.

normal.name: WPA2 home network join karna
normal.summary: Laptop HomeNet dhoondta hai, join karta hai, 4-way handshake chalata hai aur encrypted frames bhejna shuru karta hai.

steps.title: Beacon sunna
steps.desc: Access point ek second mein das baar apna ailaan karta hai
steps.detail: Router ka radio lagbhag har 102 ms mein ek Beacon broadcast karta hai. Isme network ka naam (SSID), channel, supported speeds aur ek RSN element hota hai jo kehta hai “WPA2, password chahiye, AES-CCMP”. Isi se networks tumhari Wi-Fi list mein dikhte hain.

quiz.q: Beacon ka kaunsa hissa laptop ko batata hai ki is network ko WPA2 password chahiye?
quiz.why: RSN (Robust Security Network) element cipher (CCMP) aur login method list karta hai: AKM 2, ek pre-shared key.

steps.title: Pucho kaun hai
steps.detail: Agle beacon ka intezaar karne ke bajaye laptop seedha puch sakta hai. Woh jis network ko chahta hai uska naam likhkar Probe Request bhejta hai, aur access point Probe Response se jawab deta hai. Isme lagbhag beacon jaisi hi information hoti hai lekin sirf is laptop ko bheji jati hai.
facts: Beacons ka wait karne se tez

steps.title: Authenticate aur associate
steps.detail: “Open System authentication” security check jaisa lagta hai lekin hai nahi: yeh do-frame ka hello hai jo hamesha succeed hota hai. Phir laptop Association Request bhejta hai jisme likha hota hai ki usne kaunsi security chuni (WPA2-PSK with CCMP), aur router Association ID se jawab deta hai. Laptop ab attached hai, lekin router handshake frames ke alawa uska saara traffic abhi bhi block rakhta hai.

quiz.q: Association Response ke baad kya laptop web traffic bhej sakta hai?
options: Nahi, keys agree hone tak router sirf EAPOL handshake frames jaane deta hai
quiz.why: 802.1X port tab tak band rehta hai jab tak 4-way handshake password sabit na kar de aur keys install na ho jayein.

steps.title: Handshake: nonces badlo
steps.desc: Messages 1 aur 2: ANonce, SNonce aur ek MIC
steps.detail: Dono sides ke paas pehle se PMK hai, jo password aur SSID se nikla hai (PBKDF2, 4096 rounds). Router ek random ANonce bhejta hai. Laptop apna SNonce chunta hai, PMK + ANonce + SNonce + dono MAC addresses ko mila kar session key (PTK) banata hai, aur us key se bani MIC ke saath SNonce bhejta hai. Router wahi PTK banata hai aur MIC check karta hai: agar match ho gaya, to laptop ko password pata hi hoga.

quiz.q: Router ko message 2 mila. MIC check karne ke liye use kya chahiye?
options: Apna PMK aur message 2 ka SNonce
quiz.why: SNonce ke saath woh apne PMK se wahi PTK bana sakta hai. Agar laptop ka password alag hota, to uska PTK aur MIC match nahi karte.

steps.title: Handshake: keys install karo
steps.desc: Messages 3 aur 4: GTK mil gaya, keys install ho gayi
steps.detail: Router message 3 se jawab deta hai. Usme uski apni MIC hoti hai, jo sabit karti hai ki router ko bhi password pata hai, aur GTK (broadcasts ke liye group key) jo PTK ke ek hisse se encrypted hai. Laptop message 4 se jawab deta hai, aur dono sides keys install kar lete hain. 802.1X port khul jata hai.

steps.title: Encrypted data
steps.desc: Ab har frame mein CCMP header hota hai
steps.detail: Ab se data frames mein Protected flag set hota hai. 24-byte MAC header ke baad packet number wala 8-byte CCMP header aata hai, phir encrypted contents (LLC, IP, TCP aur baaki) aur 8-byte MIC. Radio ke saath paas mein koi bhi MAC addresses aur frame sizes dekh sakta hai, lekin andar kya hai nahi.

quiz.q: Attacker ek protected frame record karke baad mein phir bhejta hai. Use kya rokta hai?
quiz.why: Receiver aakhri PN yaad rakhta hai. Replay kiye gaye frame ka PN purana hota hai aur woh drop ho jata hai.

outro.title: Network par
outro.text: Laptop ne apne beacon se HomeNet dhoonda, Open System auth aur association se join kiya, phir 4-way handshake mein sabit kiya ki use password pata hai, bina kabhi bheje. Ab fresh keys har frame ko AES-CCMP se encrypt karti hain.

wrong-password.name: Galat password
wrong-password.summary: Password mein typo se message 2 ki MIC galat ho jati hai. Router chup rehta hai, retry karta hai, phir laptop ko nikal deta hai.

steps.title: Hamesha ki tarah join
steps.desc: Auth aur association phir bhi succeed hote hain
steps.detail: Open System authentication ya association mein kuch bhi password check nahi karta, isliye typo ke saath bhi yeh succeed hote hain. Laptop ne galat password se apna PMK bana liya hai, lekin abhi kisi ko pata nahi.

steps.title: MIC check fail
steps.desc: Message 2 aisi MIC ke saath aata hai jo router match nahi kar pata
steps.detail: Router ANonce bhejta hai aur laptop SNonce aur MIC ke saath jawab deta hai. Router asli password se apna PTK banata hai, MIC compute karta hai, aur alag value paata hai. Woh laptop ko wajah nahi batata. Bas message 2 drop kar deta hai.

quiz.q: Router “wrong password” ka reply kyun nahi deta?
options: Use sirf itna pata hai ki MIC match nahi hui; woh password khud nahi dekh sakta
Woh uske badle sahi password bhej deta hai
quiz.why: Password kabhi travel nahi karta. Router ko bas ek MIC dikhti hai jo fit nahi hoti, jo damaged ya forged frame bhi ho sakta hai.

steps.title: Retry
steps.desc: Message 1 phir se, naye replay counter ke saath
steps.detail: Koi valid reply na milne par router lagbhag ek second wait karta hai aur replay counter 2 karke message 1 phir bhejta hai. Laptop wahi galat key se jawab deta hai, isliye MIC phir fail hoti hai.

steps.title: Nikal diya gaya
steps.detail: Retries khatam hone par router reason 15 ke saath Deauthentication frame bhejta hai, “4-way handshake timeout”. Laptop ke Wi-Fi menu mein “incorrect password” dikhta hai. Kai routers failed attempt ko log bhi karte hain.

outro.title: Galat password, connection nahi
outro.text: Galat password sirf 4-way handshake mein pakda jata hai, jab message 2 ki MIC match nahi karti. Router use drop karta hai, retry karta hai, aur aakhir mein deauthentication bhejta hai. Password khud kabhi hawa mein nahi gaya.

deauth-attack.name: Deauth attack aur 802.11w
deauth-attack.summary: Attacker laptop ko nikalne ke liye forged deauthentication frames bhejta hai. Protected Management Frames unhe bekaar kar dete hain.

steps.title: Connected aur busy
steps.detail: Laptop HomeNet se joined hai aur encrypted frames bhej raha hai. Plain WPA2 mein Deauthentication jaise management frames kabhi encrypted ya signed nahi hote.

steps.title: Forged deauth
steps.desc: Attacker router banne ka natak karta hai
steps.detail: Attacker router ka MAC address sender ke roop mein likhkar Deauthentication frame bhejta hai. Check karne ke liye koi signature nahi, isliye laptop us par yakeen karke disconnect ho jata hai. Yeh har kuch seconds mein dohrane se victim network se bahar rehta hai, aur laptop ko rejoin bhi karwa sakta hai taaki attacker ek fresh handshake record kare aur offline password guess kare.

quiz.q: Laptop forged frame par yakeen kyun karta hai?
options: 802.11w ke bina deauth frames mein MIC nahi hoti, to koi bhi sender address fake kar sakta hai
Router ne attacker ko bhejne ko kaha tha
quiz.why: Plain WPA2 sirf data frames ko protect karta hai. Management frame ka sender address bas chhe bytes hain jo koi bhi likh sakta hai.

steps.title: Rejoin, handshake record hua
steps.desc: Laptop dobara connect hota hai aur attacker sunta hai
steps.detail: Laptop apne aap rejoin karta hai aur 4-way handshake phir chalata hai. Attacker messages 1 aur 2 record karta hai. ANonce, SNonce, MACs aur MIC ke saath woh ab apne computer par lakhon password guesses try kar sakta hai, isliye lamba, random WPA2 password zaroori hai.

steps.title: 802.11w (PMF) on karo
steps.desc: Forged deauth ignore ho jata hai
steps.detail: Protected Management Frames ke saath router ke asli deauth frames data ki tarah encrypted hote hain aur unme MIC hoti hai. Forged frame mein Protected flag nahi hota, isliye laptop connection nahi todta. Uske bajaye woh encrypted link par router se puchta hai (SA Query) ki kya woh sach mein disconnect karna chahta hai. Router sahi jawab deta hai, aur laptop bana rehta hai.
facts: SA Query chalata hai, disconnect nahi

quiz.q: PMF on hone par laptop ko router se aaya hua dikhta unprotected deauth milta hai. Woh kya karta hai?
options: Protected link par router se puchta hai (SA Query) aur router jawab de to bana rehta hai
Router ko apna password bhejta hai
quiz.why: Asli router apna deauth protect karta. SA Query exchange sabit karta hai ki encrypted association abhi zinda hai.

outro.title: Deauth attacks ruk gaye
outro.text: 802.11w ke bina koi bhi deauthentication frame forge karke devices ko nikal sakta hai aur offline guessing ke liye handshakes capture kar sakta hai. Protected Management Frames in frames ko encrypt aur sign karte hain, isliye fakes ignore hote hain aur SA Query asli link confirm karta hai.
